# Performance · scale out

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Load balancing
- What: Spread traffic across several servers.
- Applies when: one server is no longer enough.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### Autoscaling
- What: Add and remove servers automatically as traffic rises and falls.
- Applies when: traffic rises and falls a lot.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### Sharding
- What: Split one database's data across several databases.
- Applies when: one database can no longer hold the data.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### CDN & edge
- What: Serve files from servers close to each user.
- Applies when: users are far from the server.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable
